title: Ensure AAP Organization, Inventory, and Hosts
description: Ensures an AAP organization and inventory exist, then adds missing hosts to the inventory and reports existing, added, and failed hosts.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_host
parameters.description: AAP controller hostname or IP address.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: Name of the AAP organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: Name of the AAP inventory to ensure exists within the organization.

parameters.name: host_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames to ensure are present in the inventory.

playbook_output.description: Emits inventory_name, organization_name, existing_hosts, added_hosts, and failed_hosts.

fields.name: existing_hosts
fields.description: List of hosts that already existed in the inventory.

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: List of hosts that were newly added to the inventory.

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: List of hosts that failed to be added.

steps.name: Look up existing organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an organization matching the given name.

steps.name: Determine organization existence
steps.function: Derive a boolean flag indicating whether the organization lookup found a result.

computations._org_exists: True if _existing_org contains at least one result, false otherwise.

steps.name: Does the organization exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the organization lookup found a matching organization.
steps.condition: The organization existence flag is true.

steps.name: Create the organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Look up existing inventory
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an inventory matching the given name inside the given organization.

steps.name: Determine inventory existence
steps.function: Derive a boolean flag indicating whether the inventory lookup found a result.

computations._inventory_exists: True if _existing_inventory contains at least one result, false otherwise.

steps.name: Does the inventory exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the inventory lookup found a matching inventory.
steps.condition: The inventory existence flag is true.

steps.name: Create the inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.inventory module.

steps.name: Prepare host list
steps.function: Split the comma-separated host_list parameter into a list of host names.

steps.name: Add missing hosts
steps.function: Loop over the input host list and ensure each host is present in the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.host module. Continue on failures and record per-host results.

steps.name: Verify hosts in inventory
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for hosts present in the given inventory and organization after host addition.

steps.name: Classify host results
steps.function: Derive lists of existing hosts, added hosts, and failed hosts from the per-host results collected in step-10.

computations._existing_hosts: Keep entries from _host_add_results where the host already existed (changed is false) and collect the host name.
computations._added_hosts: Keep entries from _host_add_results where the host was added (changed is true) and collect the host name.
computations._failed_hosts: Keep entries from _host_add_results where failed is true and collect the host name.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Ensure organization and inventory
phases.description: Check for and create the AAP organization and inventory if missing.

phases.name: Host management
phases.description: Prepare the host list, ensure all hosts are present in the inventory, verify the result, and classify per-host outcomes.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
